checks.degree_identity: Exact Artificial Intelligence, BA heading; 2026-2027 Bulletin; distinct award record.
checks.required_and_choices: Independently read fixed core: MATH 121, MATH 307, CSDS 233, CSDS 302, CSDS 310, CSDS 330, CSDS 340, CSDS 395A. Introductory programming is CSDS 134 OR the complete CSDS 132+237 bundle, never three fixed requirements. Calculus II and probability are also alternatives; BS calculus III is an alternative.
checks.elective_pools: All named major-pool descriptions independently read (78 distinct identities across BA/BS). BA application alternatives retain the one 3–4-unit or two 1.5-unit route; current SCMG 462/463 descriptions impose graduate-program enrollment, conditional on the registrar’s requisite and, where applicable, separate career permission process. BS any-CSDS and prior-approval open options remain explicitly open. General-education subject review is still in progress.
checks.prerequisites: All named major descriptions reviewed, including credit exclusions, placements, invitation-only physics and permission-based advanced courses. CSDS 102 must precede any 300-level CSDS enrollment; CSDS 499 has an explicit permission alternative to graduate standing. SCMG 462/463 retain their named master’s-program enrollment restriction; the separately reviewed registrar policy provides a conditional requisite/other-condition override and school career-permission process, not a guaranteed waiver. Prerequisites are not promoted to fixed degree obligations. First UGER batch preserves 59 additional identities’ observed prerequisites/corequisites, permission and credit exclusions; this includes AIQS registration placeholders and advisor consent, without making them new fixed degree courses.
checks.credits_and_units: Individual amounts observed for all named major course blocks, including 1.5-unit application courses. Description headers say Units; previously corroborated credit-hour units retained, otherwise unknown. No inferred semester-hour conversion.
checks.classification: All 59 named major identities now have actual-description category reviews and original summaries. Mixed courses remain other with explicit candidate categories. General-education-only classifications remain legacy/unreviewed; independent overall profile is not yet established. First UGER batch adds 59 actual-description reviews; 118 program records now have independent subject reviews. Remaining 626 general-education records are still legacy/unreviewed.
checks.family_composition: No family inheritance; BA and BS have independent catalog curricula and stable IDs.
checks.degree_wide_requirements: Full university/award-specific bachelor policy prose and UGER governing policy prose independently reread. Verified cohort, credit/GPA/residency rules, breadth outside STEM+N, overlap, transfer/appeal, mandatory communication/portfolio and wellness duration. Corrected mandatory communication parent ancestry and ESL-only AIQS120 summary scope. All thirteen published approval tables independently reread, including eight entire bundles and eight approved non-course activities; general-education course descriptions/classifications remain unfinished.

discrepancies.issue: All computing foundations fell through a narrow shared title heuristic into other; CSDS discrete mathematics and BS engineering-impact subject were also misclassified.
discrepancies.correction: Case-specific exact code/title map plus independently parsed official description evidence; source-backed manual category_review and paraphrases. The generic helper and shared profile are unchanged.

discrepancies.issue: BA application listing conflicts with graduate-only SCMG 462/463 enrollment restrictions.
discrepancies.correction: Earlier conflict interpretation superseded by actual registrar policies covering unmet course conditions and separate cross-career permissions. Retain exact enrollment restrictions and conditional approval route; restore BA scoped inventory complete, while full correctness audit remains in progress.

discrepancies.issue: Mandatory communication sequence was represented by a note parent, suppressing its four explicit choice pools into unresolved roles.
discrepancies.correction: Changed the communication parent to all; inquiry/CI/DC/capstone retain source counts and complete bundled alternatives. Portfolio policy remains prose. Wellness duration remains unresolved because semester-equivalent selection is not a fixed course-count choice.

discrepancies.issue: Inquiry summary implied everyone outside preparatory English enters AIQS 120.
discrepancies.correction: Restricted the direct AIQS 120 observation to some students for whom English is a second language, matching the actual source scope.

discrepancies.issue: Java programming appears under CSDS132 in the major and ECSE132 in the UGER pool; counting both as independent courses duplicates an explicitly cross-listed identity.
discrepancies.correction: Retained both records and registered one reviewed cross-list group from reciprocal course-description statements. CSDS134 remains a distinct alternative; credit exclusion alone is not equivalence.

programs.correction_status: Named major and first UGER course reviews plus required-choice and permission-policy corrections; remaining accessible general-education review in progress

remaining_work.issue: All named major descriptions reviewed; remaining accessible general-education-only identities/descriptions/categories and full policy second pass are unfinished.
General-education course identity/description/category review remains unfinished; all thirteen approved tables and governing UGER/bachelor policy prose have now been independently reread.
